name: D&D 2024 Immutable Item Definition
description: One immutable, source-cited D&D 2024 physical-item definition revision. The definition entity id is the durable reference later item instances store exactly; a correction creates a new entity revision rather than rewriting this one. Static physical facts, ordinary capacity, currency conversion, equipment-state eligibility, and the optional weapon-profile link belong together here. It stores no physical instance, custody, quantity, current equipment state, price, or combat result. A weapon definition may point to the existing canonical weapon profile but never copies combat statistics. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.item-definition.
